blocks.text: Ship more client work without hiring more account managers.
We automate the parts of agency life nobody wants to do: client reports, briefs, ad ops, content production, status updates. Your team stays on the creative.
Agencies and brands we ship for
The stack we ship on
Production stopped being the bottleneck.
The bottleneck moved to orchestration. Claude Code drives the agents, MCP plugs into HubSpot, Slack, Notion, your DAM, and your ad platforms. Campaigns ship in days.

What we automate for marketing agencies
Client reporting, brief intake, asset routing, status updates, ad QA. The repetitive work that quietly burns 30% of your team's week.
Client reports
Performance pulled from every ad platform and analytics tool, written up in your voice, sent on schedule.
Creative briefs
Client calls and Slack threads turned into structured briefs your creative team can actually start from.
Ad ops
Asset resizing, UTM tagging, naming conventions, and QA are handled before launch, not after the client notices.
Account updates
Status emails, recap notes, and check-ins drafted from real project data. Your AM approves and sends.
Client reporting that doesn't eat Mondays
The first half of every week shouldn't be spent in Looker Studio. We pull the data, write the recap, and deliver in your format.
Reports that read like your AM wrote them
Templated metrics aren't the problem. Commentary is. Our agents draft the narrative, your team edits in minutes.
Pulls from every platform: Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, GA4, your CRM.
Written in your voice: trained on your past reports, not generic AI prose.
Delivered your way: Slides, PDF, Notion, or straight into the client's Slack.
15+ hours back per AM per week
That's the average across agencies we've shipped reporting for. Same retainer, more capacity for strategy.
Briefs in, content out, without the back-and-forth
Creative output stalls at the brief. We turn client conversations into structured briefs your team can actually build from, and route them straight into production.
Brief intake that captures what the client actually meant
Discovery calls, Loom feedback, Slack messages, all parsed into one brief with goals, audience, deliverables, and constraints.
Scope locked early: changes get logged, not forgotten.
Brand guardrails baked in: tone, banned words, visual rules pulled from your style guide.
Routed automatically: straight into Asana, ClickUp, or whatever your producers live in.
Ad ops and asset management, on rails
Resizing, naming, UTM tagging, platform QA: it's where junior time goes to die. Run it as a pipeline instead.
From master file to every placement
One source creative, resized and reformatted for every platform spec, named to your convention, tagged correctly, ready to launch.
DAM-aware: assets land where your team already looks.
QA before launch: spec violations, broken UTMs, and copy issues flagged.
Versioning that holds: v3-FINAL-final stops being a filename.
Searchable asset library
Every asset auto-tagged with client, campaign, format, and performance. Find the winning Q3 hook in seconds, not 40 minutes.
